criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Reference-image and multi-subject routes are documented, but no controlled exact-product run verifies first-10-seconds identity.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Publisher samples and benchmark tables exist; AIVP has not inspected a controlled accepted output and the repository warns of inconsistent beta quality.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Reference, pose, structural, keyframe, seed and editing controls are documented; repeatability across identical runs is untested.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: CLI and ComfyUI routes cover generation, control, editing and repair, but setup requires very large local packages and specialist hardware.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: Single-H100 warm benchmarks are published; cold start, end-to-end render time and failure rate are unverified.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Weights are ungated, but suitable hardware, energy/provider cost and cost per accepted output are unresolved.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: The MiniMax H3 community licence applies in Australia and disclaims MiniMax ownership of outputs, subject to territorial, disclosure, attribution and acceptable-use restrictions; input rights remain separate.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: Scripted CLI and ComfyUI workflows exist; no hosted API, MCP or production monitoring path is verified.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Australia is inside the stated licence territory, but H100-class execution and package size are poor indie-creator fit.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: No affiliate or partner programme was found and transactional demand is unmeasured.

analysis: A materially differentiated unified multimodal video beta with real reference/control breadth, but no AIVP hands-on proof and impractical current local requirements.
confidence_notes: Primary repository, model-package, paper and licence evidence only; no AIVP generation.

hard_gates.product_affiliate: UNRESOLVED — reference support is documented but exact-product retention is untested.
hard_gates.publication: First Look only; commercial input rights and hands-on evidence are absent.
hard_gates.integration: BLOCKED — security audit, suitable GPU, storage margin and cost route unresolved.
